题目.题目1:
【听力】听录音，回答问题：什么让大家很担心？
听：The disappearance of the little girl worried everyone.
A. 下大雨
B. 停电
C. 小女孩失踪了
D. 考试
题目.题目2:
【单项选择】选出最恰当的一项。
题干：The ______ of the dinosaurs is still a mystery.
A. disappear
B. disappeared
C. disappearance
D. disappearing
题目.题目3:
【选词填空】从 disappear、disappearance 中选一个，用适当形式填空。
题干：The plane ______ from the radar last night.
考点：词性转换
题目.题目4:
【适当形式填空】用所给单词的适当形式填空。
题干：There have been several strange ______ in the forest. (disappearance)
考点：变形
题目.题目5:
【改错】句子里有一处错误，找出来并改正。
题干：His disappear surprised his family.
考点：词性转换
题目.题目6:
【单项选择】选出最恰当的一项。
题干：The opposite of "disappearance" is ______.
A. appearance
B. attendance
C. difference
D. distance
考点：易混
题目.题目7:
【单项选择】选出最恰当的一项。
题干：We were worried ______ the disappearance of the dog.
A. about
B. of
C. at
D. on
考点：用法
题目.答案:
【1】C（小女孩失踪了）
讲解：disappearance 消失、失踪。
【2】C（disappearance）
讲解：the … of 中间要名词 disappearance。
【3】disappeared
讲解：last night 用动词 disappear 的过去式。
【4】disappearances
讲解：several 后面接复数。
【5】disappear → disappearance
讲解：his 后面要名词 disappearance。
【6】A（appearance）
讲解：消失 ↔ 出现 appearance。
【7】A（about）
讲解：be worried about 为……担心。
